VALID_STATUS_VALUES.projectProvisioningValidatorAllowed: Requires presence of non-empty status string

findings.ROOT_CAUSE: The Project Setup UI (ProjectSetupWizard.tsx line 249) submits status: 'SETUP' as designed for the Phase 1 Foundation setup lifecycle. However, projectService.createProject calls ProjectValidator.validate(), which contains a legacy hardcoded check (src/validators/project.validator.ts line 33) enforcing only ['ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'ARCHIVED']. Because 'SETUP' is omitted from the validator's whitelist, validation fails with 'حالة المشروع غير صالحة'. Additionally, projectService.createProject calls ProjectNumberGenerator.getNextProjectNumber() before validation, causing validation failures to consume project sequence numbers.
findings.CURRENT_PROJECT_SEQUENCE: Sequence counter is incremented in Firestore/memory during getNextProjectNumber() before validation runs; a failed validation leaves an unused sequence number.
findings.REQUIRED_FIX: 1. Update src/validators/project.validator.ts line 33 to include all valid ProjectEntity status lifecycle values: ['DRAFT', 'SETUP', 'READY_FOR_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'ARCHIVED', 'PLANNING']. 2. In src/services/project.service.ts, run payload validation before invoking ProjectNumberGenerator.getNextProjectNumber() to prevent sequence number exhaustion on invalid requests.
